neighbours.label: measuring and marking steps in DIY / sewing instructions, peaking on the function word after the action ('measure from the', 'mark the holes with', 'mask the surfaces with')
fire: Measure from the floor to the top of the window frame and write it down.
Mark the position of each screw hole with a sharp pencil.
Using a tape measure, find the center of the wall and mark it with a cross.
Snap a chalk line across the board about four inches from the end.
For the hem, measure from the waist down to just below the knee.
Outline the shape on the plywood with a marker before cutting.
Measure the gap between the cabinets with a steel rule.
Mark a line two inches in from each edge of the fabric with tailor's chalk.
quiet: Let the paint dry overnight before you hang the curtains on the window frame.
Drive each screw in slowly so the wood does not split.
Once the glue has set, sand the wall smooth and wipe off the dust.
Cut the board to length and sand the rough end until it is smooth.
For the hem, fold the fabric over twice and sew it in place.
Cut out the shape from the plywood carefully with a jigsaw.
Fit the new hinges to the cabinets and hang the doors.
Press the seams open with a hot iron and trim any loose threads.
